audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart says 'Skill' on six of seven rows while content, packet and prose all describe Karma owning 1-4 and Swain owning 6 onward.
audit.why: Her level-1 Mantra-Q at 950 range out-pokes Swain's 750 Q until 6; from 6 Demonic Ascension plus E is an all-in a dashless enchanter cannot escape, and first-item sustain outheals her poke.
audit.corrected: phases[1..3].side to Karma, phases[4..6].side to Swain, whys and ratings rewritten to match.

audit.why: Spikes correctly frame her 3-5 poke window, your 6 flip, your first-item takeover, and late dominance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no numbers; itemization never mentioned anti-heal despite her Mantra-W heal (flagged missing interaction); do/don't bullets were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat, Mantra 40s at rank 1 — her whole shield/heal economy keys off it; her W heals on the Mantra cast so Grievous Wounds timing matters in extended trades.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns; Oblivion Orb vs her Mantra-W heal added to itemization; bullet bodies rewritten to match titles.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Nevermove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (Tether): 12s — break it with range before the root lands; its downtime is your trade light. - Mantra: 40s at rank 1 — down means no big shield and no empowered heal; commit there. - Guard your 12s E; the R goes to kill windows only.
